text: 1. Healthy individuals (free from infectious diseases and physical or mental disorders that affect normal study), with good conduct, of non-Chinese nationality. 2. Educational Requirements: Applicants for the doctoral program must hold a master's degree. 3. Language Requirements: Applicants for English-taught programs, except those whose native language is English, are required to provide proof of English proficiency such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO (excluding TOEFL ITP scores) or proof of previous English-taught courses; applicants for Chinese-taught programs are required to provide a certificate of HSK4 or above (or above) or proof of previous Chinese-taught courses. 4. Age requirement: For those applying to pursue a doctoral degree, the age should generally not exceed 45 years old.
